1: "I have loved you," says the Lord. The priests offer blind and lame animals. "From the rising of the sun to its setting, a pure offering is made to my name among the nations."
The Church sees in that verse a prophecy of the Mass, quoted in the Eucharistic Prayer.
2: Priests have turned many from the way. Men are divorcing the wives of their youth.
God seeks faithful teaching and faithful marriage.
3: "I send my messenger to prepare the way. The Lord will suddenly come to his Temple," like a refiner's fire. Bring the full tithe.
The messenger is John the Baptist.
4: The day is coming, burning like an oven. For those who fear God's name the sun of justice will rise with healing in its wings. Elijah will come first.
The last words of the prophets point straight to the Gospel.
